scope: Independent alpha-aware surface samples on actual paired native geometry. Current decoded live UVs are accepted only after exact baseline position/index equality; candidate UVs follow unchanged per-triangle index correspondence. Counts classify triangle-sample distance to wood, not whole-clump connectivity or subjective visible quality. Additional graph counts use opaque-sample bounding boxes, a spanning forest at gap 0.7/max(1,maxScale), and wood contact reach 0.6/max(1,maxScale). These are shared-template diagnostic components, not the pinned visual audit or proof that no floating foliage exists. The exploratory policy was rejected and is not in the production feature.
